description: React component for editing a product in an e-commerce admin interface, connected to Redux store, handling product fetch, reset, and update actions.

classes.name: Edit
classes.description: React component class for editing a product, managing lifecycle methods and rendering the edit form or not found message.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Lifecycle method that resets the product state and fetches product data and brands when component mounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Lifecycle method that refetches product data if the product ID in URL params changes.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the SubPage with either the EditProduct component or NotFound message based on product existence.
